fm.title: Analog io
fm.description: Analog input/output via DAQ hardware (2 blocks)

rows.intent: Read analog voltage from DAQ hardware in real time — use for acquiring sensor signals at deterministic sample rates on the desktop
Write analog voltage to DAQ hardware in real time — use for generating control signals to actuators at deterministic sample rates

fm.title: Digital io
fm.description: Digital, counter, and encoder I/O (6 blocks)

rows.intent: Generate servo control signals via real-time hardware — use for driving RC servos or positioning actuators from desktop real-time models
Read hardware counter values in real time — use for measuring encoder counts, pulse frequencies, or event timing
Read digital channels from DAQ hardware in real time — use for acquiring switch states or digital sensor signals
Write digital channels to DAQ hardware in real time — use for controlling relays, indicators, or digital actuators
Read quadrature encoder position in real time — use for measuring motor shaft angle or linear position with hardware decoding
Generate a frequency signal via DAQ hardware — use for producing clock outputs or variable-frequency drive signals

fm.title: Iot profiling
fm.description: IoT connectivity and execution profiling (6 blocks)

rows.intent: Example models for Simulink Desktop Real-Time — use as reference for setting up real-time I/O configurations
Synchronize model execution to real-time clock — use as the essential block that enables desktop real-time mode for any model
Read data from ThingSpeak IoT platform in real time — use for incorporating cloud sensor data into real-time desktop simulations
Write data to ThingSpeak IoT platform in real time — use for uploading measurement data to the cloud during real-time operation
Measure task execution time of the real-time model — use for profiling computational load and detecting timing overruns
Read the real-time clock timestamp — use for precise time-stamping of events or measuring actual execution timing

fm.title: Streaming
fm.description: Packet and stream-based data exchange (7 blocks)

rows.intent: Read vendor-specific input channels — use for accessing custom or non-standard DAQ hardware inputs
Write vendor-specific output channels — use for accessing custom or non-standard DAQ hardware outputs
Receive raw data packets from hardware — use for reading structured binary data from custom I/O devices in real time
Send raw data packets to hardware — use for transmitting structured binary commands to custom I/O devices in real time
Receive streaming data from hardware — use for continuous data acquisition from serial or network devices in real time
Send streaming data to hardware — use for continuous data output to serial or network devices in real time
Capture video frames from hardware in real time — use for real-time image acquisition from cameras or frame grabbers
